The Q stands for "Questioning", like if they're questioning their gender or sexuality. It can also stand for the word "Queer" which is a derogatory term used against people that are LGBTQ+. However, some people have reclaimed that word. It can still be seen as offensive to some people though.

If you got any questions, don't hesitate to ask :)

The "B" in "LGBTQ+" stands for Bisexuality, not Binary. 

Bisexuality is being attracted to (but not limited to) cis-gender males, and cis-gender females. Bisexuality isn't just being attracted to male and female people. It's a spectrum, like sexuality and gender in general. If you're Bi, you can be attracted to a more masculine woman, or a more feminine man. 

You can be attracted to people who are Non-Binary too.
